results.description:
**Stay off your phone and a tree grows. Leave early and it withers. That's Forest, the focus timer used by 60 million people worldwide.**

Top productivity app in 136 countries. Recommended by The New York Times and Business Insider.

"Forest works well, and if your goal is to be more in the moment, ignore your phone and actually talk to your friends when you are with them, this is the app for you." — The New York Times

Together, our community has planted over 2 million real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future.

---

STAY FOCUSED

Forest helps you overcome phone addiction, reduce distractions, and build deep work habits. Whether you are studying for exams, working from home, or simply trying to be more present, Forest gives you a reason to stay on task.

- A gamified focus timer that turns screen-free time into a growing virtual forest
- Create personalized Allow Lists to block distracting apps during focus sessions (iOS 16 or above)
- Track your daily phone usage and screen time

GET MOTIVATED

- Unlock tree species and soundscapes as you reach focus milestones
- Co-plant trees with friends and family during shared focus sessions
- Compete with users around the world and share your forest
- Unlock achievements and earn extra rewards
- Plant real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future

TIME GUARD: BLOCK DISTRACTIONS ON SCHEDULE

Time Guard helps you set phone-free windows throughout your day. Block distracting apps on a schedule, limit when you can access them, and track how much time you spend on your phone.

MINDFUL SPACE: RESET YOUR MIND

Mindful Space combines calming soundscapes, breathing exercises, and gentle animations to help you decompress between focus sessions. 

STATISTICS & INSIGHTS

- Create custom tags and view detailed statistics of how you spend your focused time
- Review your weekly, monthly, and yearly focus history as a visual forest
- Revisit your focus journey with Forest Timeline
- Sync your focused time with Apple Health

It is never too late to build better habits.

---

FOREST PLUS

Love Forest? Try Forest Plus.

- 3x coin rewards and unlock new trees faster
- Exclusive Plus-only tree species and early access to seasonal new trees
- Turn your focus into a real tree on Earth

Start your free trial today, cancel anytime.

---

NOTICE

Forest is available on iPhone and iPad. Sign in with the same account to sync your data and access Forest Plus across all platforms.

The Allow List feature requires iOS/iPadOS 16 or above. Forest is the original app. Similar apps on the App Store are not developed by the Forest team.

---

Follow us on Instagram or visit forestapp.cc to learn more. Browser extensions also available.

---

Designed for high-achieving students and productivity enthusiasts, Flipd has helped millions of users reach their daily, weekly, and monthly productivity goals. If you’re working toward any goal, like studying for final exams or learning something new, track your progress and stay motivated with Flipd, a sophisticated and beautifully designed productivity timer.

Here’s how Flipd helps improve your productivity & concentration, and reduces procrastination:

CUSTOM PRODUCTIVITY TIMERS
• Improve concentration with custom productivity timers
• Keep track of the time you’re putting toward a certain subject or activity
• Add #tags for each activity 
• Categorize your tags & keep them organized in an activity library
• Enable multitask mode to let your timer run in the background
• Set up reminders for your productivity sessions
• Keep track of breaks

STATS & INSIGHTS
• Visualize your history and progress on a calendar
• Measure and compare your stats over days, weeks, and months
• Get insights like average productive time, day streaks, milestones, and more
• Collect badges for reaching certain milestones 

MOTIVATION & ENCOURAGEMENT
• Thoughtfully designed to make you feel good about your progress
• Feel motivated by reducing procrastination and distractions
• Prepare for each productivity session with an inspiring quote
• Feel encouraged after completing a session with rewarding stats
• Collect badges to illustrate your achievements
• Stay motivated to keep going!

CHALLENGE & COMPETE
• Join global leaderboards with other users
• Compete in daily, weekly, and monthly challenges
• Stay accountable toward your goals

LIVE FEED & STUDY ROOMS
• Create or join live study rooms and groups to study with your friends or clubs

• Follow your friends activities and cheer them on

OTHER FEATURES

results.description:
Flora is a new way to stay off your phone, clear to-do lists, and build positive, life-changing habits. Whenever you want to make progress towards your goals, plant a seed in Flora. As you work hard, the seed will grow into a healthy tree. Let the tree be your coach and grow yourself with it. You will be amazed by how great you can be.

FOCUS TREES

Have trouble putting down the phone? Flora blocks distracting apps in a pleasant way to help you focus on what’s more important in real life. If you cannot resist the temptation of using your phone and leave the app while growing a tree, the tree will be killed! But if succeeding, you'll unlock new trees.

DOUBLE EFFICIENCY WITH FRIENDS 

Things get even more interesting when you challenge your friends to plant trees together—you will see who kills a tree (ouch). However, if you successfully stay away from your phones together, each of you will win an additional tree from a random friend. You can also chat and share your progress to motivate each other and keep everyone on track.*

* Flora is the original app for multi-user tree planting and delivers the best features that help you and your friends be productive. 

TO-DO LIST & WIDGET

Flora is a to-do list, and more. Simply create a to-do item and set a reminder, then you will never forget a thing. Even better, you can tag your trees with a to-do item to easily track the progress towards each of your life goals. No matter if your goal is daily, weekly, or monthly, Flora will help you follow it through and achieve it.

HABIT TRACKER

Enjoy a rewarding daily habit routine. If you grow trees regularly, you will earn yourself a beautiful, vibrant garden. Take a look at it and feel proud of yourself! Each tree records your perseverance and a step towards a healthy life. You can also view the daily, weekly, or monthly statistics of your activities in Flora to find opportunities to improve your time-management and planning skills.

REAL TREES, REAL IMPACT

Why not plant REAL trees while improving yourself? Flora proudly offers the opt-in Price and Care services that let you plant real trees on the earth if you kill or successfully grow a tree in the app. We partner with tree-planting organizations in Africa and East Asia, such as the Trees.org and Eden Reforestation Projects, to plant fast-growing soil rebuilding trees, fruit trees that diversify incomes and nutrition, and trees that can provide forage and fuel-wood. All these trees help make the earth greener and provide long-term financial aid to families who need it most.

Sounds good? Download Flora and join our 2,000,000+ productive users now!

results.releaseNotes:
This update brings 20+ feature updates and experience improvements, mainly around iPhone Duo, landscape support, and Statistics.

- Major Update: Now fully optimized for iPhone Duo.
- Major Update: iPhone now supports landscape orientation.

Timer

- Improved: White noise now fades in and out smoothly instead of starting or stopping abruptly.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where the timer dropped a second as soon as a focus session started.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where new tomatoes rose from the bottom of the screen and then fell back down after a focus session ended.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where the timer digits were briefly cut off after giving up a focus session.

Timeline

- New: The Timeline now remembers your last selected view: 1-day, 2-day, 3-day, or week.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where paused periods in stopwatch sessions were not shown.

Statistics

- Improved: Focus time is now counted by when it actually happened. For example, a session from 9:30 to 14:30 is split across each hour instead of being counted entirely in the hour it started. Your total focus time stays the same.
- Improved: Returning from Statistics to the Home page now feels smoother.

Other Improvements

- Improved: iCloud sync error messages are now more accurate and no longer incorrectly report "iCloud storage is full."
- Improved: Updated for the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 18 Pro series.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where the app could occasionally freeze after launch.
- Improved: Fixed an issue where switches on the membership page were hard to see in Dark Mode.
- Improved: Fixed an extra transparent bar at the top of pages on Mac.
- Improved: Fixed the top row of tomatoes on the Home screen getting stuck and not falling on iOS 27.2.

If you run into any issues or have a feature you'd like to see, feel free to let us know anytime.
We'll keep refining FocusPomo so it stays simple, beautiful, and easy to use.
results.description:
FocusPomo is a Pomodoro-based time management app with a minimal and beautiful design, powerful features, and a rewarding sense of progress.

Our mission is to improve and protect your attention. That’s why we don’t simply pile on features, and we don’t use addictive game-like rewards. FocusPomo is built to help you focus on one thing at a time.

## When you may need FocusPomo

1. You work hard, but still don’t feel real progress
2. Your study or work efficiency feels low
3. You get distracted easily and want to reduce procrastination
4. Important things keep getting delayed
5. You want to become more disciplined
6. You want different parts of your life to gradually get better
7. You have many things you want to do, but keep making slow progress

## FocusPomo Core Features

1. Real-time sync across all platforms. Sync through iCloud across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, so your focus data always stays up to date.

2. A simple and easy-to-use focus timer. No flashy design, no complicated distractions. Everything is designed for a better focus experience.

3. Cute little tomatoes that make focus feel rewarding. Every completed Pomodoro gives you a cute little tomato. Your tomatoes accumulate each week, making effort more visible without turning focus into a distracting game. Tomatoes also support motion response and haptic feedback (motion response is currently supported on iOS only).

4. Powerful focus statistics. View focus trends, Pomodoro insights, and detailed data across different tasks and time ranges.

5. Calendar timeline. Reflection helps you improve. View your focus time distribution by one day, two-day comparison, or one week.

6. Optimized for iPad and Mac large screens. View more useful information and enjoy a focus experience designed for larger screens.

7. Mac support. View timer status, focus task, and today’s focus data from the menu bar. Start, pause, or end focus sessions without opening the app.

8. Apple Watch App that works independently. No iPhone needed. Start a timer, create or edit focus tasks, and manage focus directly on Apple Watch.

## FocusPomo Design Philosophy

1. Focus. We don’t build an all-in-one product. We focus on time management and help make your effort truly pay off.

2. Simplicity. Simplicity is not the goal. It is the result. Every feature and detail is carefully researched, considered, and refined.

3. Warmth. FocusPomo hopes to become a small quiet space for you, staying with you through your effort, focus, and growth.

## More Features

* App blacklist to block distracting apps
* Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, and interactive widgets
* Live Activities and Dynamic Island
* Landscape StandBy mode for focus sessions
* Custom countdown timer
* Stopwatch mode with pause support
* Different focus tags can have different focus durations
* Apple Health sync
* Manually add focus time
* Custom Pomodoro cycles, long breaks, and short breaks
* Custom focus tags
* Extend focus sessions
* Alarm reminders
* Focus trends by task and time range
* Calendar timeline by 1 day, 2 days, or 1 week
* Optimized for iPad and Mac large screens
* The current Lifetime plan includes all future updates, including Watch and Mac
* And many more features

## 6000+ reviews from users around the world, 59000+ five-star ratings

“No bloat, no unnecessary features fighting for attention — just clean timers that keep me locked in.”

“Collecting Pomodoros makes it a fun and unique experience.”

“Simple but deep”

“Helps me stay on track working from home.”

“One of the very few apps I’ve kept in my phone… Definitely worth the penny.”
